definitions.gloss: to fail to hear; to miss hearing
definitions.explanation: to not catch what was said, either by accident or inattention

definitions.gloss: to let slip; to not pursue what was heard
definitions.explanation: to deliberately overlook something problematic that was said

notes:
{聞|き}き{逃|のが}す means either accidentally missing what was said or deliberately overlooking something.

VERB TYPE:
- Godan verb (す-verb)
- Transitive

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to hear) + ⟦{逃|のが}す→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧ (to let escape)
- Part of the ～⟦{逃|のが}す→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧ compound pattern

SENSE 1 (ACCIDENTAL):
- Missing information unintentionally
- Common in noisy environments
- Used with announcements, names, explanations

SENSE 2 (DELIBERATE):
- Choosing not to respond to something problematic
- {聞|き}き⟦{逃|のが}せない→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧ (cannot be overlooked) is very common
- Often in contexts of insults or inappropriate remarks

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{聞|き}き{逃|のが}す (miss hearing a name)
- ⟦アナウンス→アナウンス：10700_anaunsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{聞|き}き{逃|のが}す (miss an announcement)
- ⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{聞|き}き{逃|のが}す (miss important information)
- {聞|き}き⟦{逃|のが}せない→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧ (cannot be ignored)

CONTRAST WITH {聞|き}き{流|なが}す:
- {聞|き}き{逃|のが}す: Failed to hear or can't ignore
- ⟦{聞|き}き{流|なが}す→聞き流す：07927_kikinagasu⟧: Deliberately ignored, let pass

RELATED COMPOUND VERBS:
- ⟦{見逃|みのが}す→見逃す：04576_minogasu⟧ (to overlook, miss seeing)
- ⟦{取|と}り{逃|のが}す→取り逃す：21338_torinogasu⟧ (to let slip, miss catching)
- ⟦{聞|き}き{流|なが}す→聞き流す：07927_kikinagasu⟧ (to let pass, ignore)

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in everyday conversation.
